title: For Thailand Market: Add TIS Mandatory Attributes to Several Categories

# Which markets are affected?
The updates of the requirements apply to local to local and cross border sellers in the Thailand market.
# Who is affected?
Developers with applications that use [Create Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/create-product-202309), [Edit Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/edit-product-202509), and [Partial Edit Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/partial-edit-product-202509#Back%20To%20Top)
# Which version is applicable?
The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs
# What action is required?
Without these mandatory attributes sellers will not be able to create and update products.
Use the Get Attributes to check what attributes are mandatory and pass attribute values via the Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product to help sellers fill in the attribute values.
